Unbreakable.Description: Teleport block are unbreakable in survival

StabilityTeleportMode.Description: Enabling the teleport stability mode. If on, teleport will be unstable at low temporal stability (lower than StabilityConsumable) and during storms. If always, then everytime will be unstable

StabilityConsumable.Description: Consumption of stability for teleport if stability is not enough <data deleted>. Percentage values from 0 to 1

UnstableTeleportRange.Description: Range for unstable teleport <data deleted> behavior

DarknessMode.Description: Remove all paper and metal lanterns from teleport structures if True

BiomlessTeleports.Description: Create only standard teleports with granite and aged wood

TeleportBuildProtected.Description: Create claim for teleport structure (does not affect generated structures)

DefaultTeleportIcon.Description: Default repaired teleport icon on the map

NoSpecialTeleports.Description: Disable trader, locust and tower teleport structures
